fields.value: Replication Data for: Hot-cold reciprocation gaps

dsDescriptionValue.value: Dataset and code for paper "Hot-cold reciprocation gaps" that studies whether and why the mode of decision making affects reciprocation in a binary trust game, using three preregistered online experiments.
